questions.prompt: Bamwe bari hanze. Bari mu gicucu cy'igiti kinini. Ndagira abandi bari mu nzu.
questions.answer: Some (people) are outside. They are in the shadow of the big tree. I suppose the others are inside (the house).

questions.prompt: Dukunda kurya imboga n'umutsima. Abandi ntibabikunda.
questions.answer: We like to eat vegetables and bread. Others don't like it.

questions.prompt: Bimwe biri hano, ibindi biri ku meza. Ni byo; bibike mu gikoni
questions.answer: Some are here; others are on the table. That's right; store them in the kitchen.

questions.prompt: Mu bitondo byose umuhungu we arakora kigabo. Abandi ntibakora cyane, ariko aba bazakora ku manywa na nijoro.
questions.answer: Every morning his son works like a man. The others don't work hard, but these will work day and night.

questions.prompt: Si byo, singaruka none. Ndashaka kuva mu mujyi. Sinywukunda.
questions.answer: That's not so; I'm not returning today. I am wanting to leave the city. I don't like it.

questions.prompt: Ibi si byiza. Ndashaka ibinini. Jya kubishaka hanze.
questions.answer: These (things) are not good. I want large ones. Go and look for them outside.

questions.prompt: Iki kigozi ni kirekire cyane; ariko uriya ni mugufi.
questions.answer: This thick string is very long, but that one is short.

questions.prompt: Uriya muhungu arakora gisaza, na kiriya kigabo kiravuga kigore.
questions.answer: That boy is working like an old man, and that hulk of a man speaks like a woman.

questions.prompt: Isake yacu ikunda kubika ku manywa na nijoro.
questions.answer: Our rooster likes to crow day and night.

questions.prompt: Uzagaruka ejo mu gitondo. Ubu ukwiriye gusubira iwanyu.
questions.answer: You will come back tomorrow morning. Now you must go back to your home.

questions.prompt: Ni byo; urakora kigabo pe! Ni byiza cyane.
questions.answer: That's it; you are working just like a man! That's very good.

questions.prompt: Umutsima n'ifi biri mu gikoni, ariko ibyuma biri hanze ku kirago.
questions.answer: The bread and fish are in the kitchen, but the knives are outside on the rug.

questions.prompt: Abantu benshi ntibakunda kiriya kigabo. Abandi bakeya n'inshuti zacyo.
questions.answer: Many people don't like that hulk of a man. A few others are his friends.
The rooster is crowing. Everyone is hearing it.

questions.prompt: Abana barasakuza cyane. Abantu bose barabumva.
questions.answer: The children are making a lot of noise. Everyone is hearing them.

questions.prompt: Bamwe barava mu gikoni, ariko abandi barasubira mu gikoni.
questions.answer: Some (people) are coming out of the kitchen, but others are going back into the kitchen.

questions.prompt: Petero ari he? Ndabizi se? Sindi umubyeyi we.
questions.answer: Where is Peter? Do I know (or Should I know)? I'm not his parent.

questions.prompt: Ni byo! Jya hanze. Urabibona kuko bimwe biri hafi, ibindi biri kure.
questions.answer: That's fine! Go outside. You will find them because some are nearby; the others are far away.

questions.prompt: Va mu nzu! Abandi barashaka kwinjira.
questions.answer: Get out of the house! Others (people) are wanting to enter.
